data.name: Flying Beast Tamer
data.description: A winged marauder acquires a flying mount as an animal companion. This works as the druid animal companion class feature, except the marauder must select a dire bat (Bestiary p.30) or giant vulture (Bestiary 3 p.312). The marauder's effective druid level is equal to his alchemist level. A marauder and his companion don't gain the share spells ability.
